Trackpad navigation implemented in handleWheel (useCanvasInteraction): ctrl/meta+wheel = pinch zoom (smooth multiplicative exp(-deltaY*0.005), per-event factor clamped 0.8-1.25); plain wheel classified by isTrackpadPanWheel heuristic (pixel deltaMode + horizontal component or |deltaY|<50 = trackpad pan; line/page mode or large quantized verticals = mouse notch step zoom). Pan reuses drag-pan rotation/scale math, document-scroll direction. Mode is sticky per wheel gesture (wheelModeRef, cleared on settle/pointer-takeover) so fast flings cannot flip pan into zoom mid-gesture. 5 new unit tests on the heuristic (2111 total green). Live-verified all 3 routes with synthetic WheelEvents - deltas matched theory to 4 decimals. Works for Windows Precision touchpads too (same Chromium event shape).
